title: Sequoia hits rewind, undoing 20 years of expansion | TechCrunch
summary: Sequoia Capital posted a memo to X on Wednesday morning titled “The Sequoia of Tomorrow” that’s full of surprises. One of the most surprising developments here is that the firm is killing two programs that put Sequoia closest to young founders.
